scope: Hitman / Chop Shop display names and dossiers; all SuperUI loading tips
state: local-unpublished; representative requested pages confirmed normal by user on 2026-10-26
translationNotes: Display-only Lua conversion uses existing sui_compare_string for native Unicode names; unique ASCII CXT tags prevent changing raw name comparisons elsewhere.
Reuse the existing Chinese dossier names for Hitman; apply one vehicle glossary to lists and dossiers.
Use font-covered alternate transliterations 彻奇尔 / 威灵顿 and equivalent vehicle nicknames where the current 2795-slot font lacks the usual glyphs.
Retain V8 as the engine designation and 555-FIRE / 555-OOPS as literal dialable phone numbers.
Loading tips avoid fixed keyboard bindings because users can remap controls.
Correct SuperUI tips about weapon/ability upgrades, garage customization, mission respect, outfit bonuses and binoculars to actual SR2 features.
Use conservative driving advice rather than asserting unverified rain or balance mechanics.
Magazine-cover lettering is baked into a texture; this revision covers the surrounding live text.
